records.context: Reads the merged arrays of ``translocation_merged_folder`` (or ``<src>/merged``). Cells are marked ``cell_source`` nucleus_territory when the territories were grown here or the merged folder's image layer layout says Make Masks grew them; the territories are not cell outlines. Then :func:`translocation_cells` per field and :func:`translocation_summary`, written to ``<src>/translocation/`` (cells_translocation.csv, the summary tables and the translocation_ratio_vs_vacuoles figure of :func:`translocation_figure`).

records.source: Reads the merged arrays of ``translocation_merged_folder`` (or ``<src>/merged``). With ``cell_from_nucleus_expand_px`` above 0 a five-plane array ``[c0, c1, c2, nucleus, parasite]`` gets its cell plane from the nuclei first (:func:`nucleus_territories`) and becomes the six-plane layout; a six-plane array already has its cell plane (Make Masks grows the territories itself with the same setting) and is read as it is. Cells are marked ``cell_source`` nucleus_territory when the territories were grown here or the merged folder's plane layout says Make Masks grew them; the territories are not cell outlines. Then :func:`translocation_cells` per field and :func:`translocation_summary`, written to ``<src>/translocation/`` (cells_translocation.csv, the summary tables and the translocation_ratio_vs_vacuoles figure of :func:`translocation_figure`).
records.translation: Les sameinuðu fylki ``translocation_merged_folder`` (eða ``<src>/merged``). Með ``cell_from_nucleus_expand_px`` yfir 0 fær fimm-plana fylki ``[c0, c1, c2, nucleus, parasite]`` fyrst frumuplan sitt út frá kjörnunum (:func:`nucleus_territories`) og verður sex-plana uppsetningin; sex-plana fylki hefur þegar frumuplan sitt (Make Masks stækkar svæðin sjálft með sömu stillingu) og er lesið eins og það er. Frumur eru merktar ``cell_source`` nucleus_territory þegar svæðin voru stækkuð hér eða uppsetning plananna í sameinuðu möppunni segir að Make Masks hafi stækkað þau; svæðin eru ekki útlínur frumna. Síðan :func:`translocation_cells` á hvert svið og :func:`translocation_summary`, skrifað í ``<src>/translocation/`` (cells_translocation.csv, samantektartöflurnar og myndina translocation_ratio_vs_vacuoles úr :func:`translocation_figure`).
